biography.en:
Naoshi Komi (古味直志, born March 28, 1986) is a Japanese manga artist. His works have debuted in Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine and its affiliates.

Komi was born in Tsuno, Takaoka District in the Aichi Prefecture.

Graduated from Art College Kobe, Komi debuted in Akamaru Jump in 2007. He said the magazine is known for featuring many newcomers. His first serialized work in Weekly Shonen Jump was Double Arts in 2008, which lasted for three tankōbon volumes.

His best known and most widely circulated work, Nisekoi, about a pair of high school students from rival gang families that are forced to be a couple, was serialized in Weekly Shōnen Jump, and has spawned a wider media franchise, including an anime series and a live-action film. 

He has cited One Piece as one of his major influences.

Favorite anime and manga: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind, Death Note, Battle Angel Alita, Yotsuba&!, and One Piece.

Hobbies: Sight seeing and taking leisure walks.

Among his assistants there was Hasegawa Tomohiro.

Диклониусы – это люди, которые мутировали по велению Господа. Кажется, что их главная миссия – уничтожать людей. Внешне они похожи на обычного человека, единственным отличием является пара рогов на голове. Кроме того, они обладают способностями телекинеза. Из-за своих навыков диклониусов содержат в лабораториях под строгим надзором. Заключенные в цепях, пленники-мутанты подвергаются жестоким экспериментом со стороны правительства. Люси – одна из заключенных, которой удалось выбраться на свободу, жестоко уничтожив всех охранников, ставших на ее пути. В итоге ей стреляют в голову и она падает в океан. Волны прибивают прекрасную девушку к берегу, где ее находит Кота и Юка – подростки. Люси теряет все свои воспоминания и даже лишается способности нормально говорить. Единственное, что она произносит – лаконичное «ню». Собственно, так подростки и прозвали незнакомку. Ее приглашают в дом Коты, одевают и пытаются помочь девушке.
Однако… в ходе событий эпичной драмы, каждая страница которой омыта кровью и слезами, вы увидите, что эта манга вовсе не так проста, как кажется на первый взгляд. Боль, несправедливость, мучение, сумасшествие и месть… Попытки найти прибежище в этом жестоком мире. Вот, что такое «Эльфийская песнь».

The Law of Justice Online, also known as LJO, is the hottest new VRMMORPG of the season, and office worker Yuta Sasaki is one of the lucky few granted access to the official launch. description.en:
One day, a 33-year-old man who spent all his time playing video games to escape reality from an unreasonable life of bullying and power harassment died. However, he was chosen as a candidate for reincarnation to another world, but the woman who guided him to his reincarnation told him that she would not give him any cheats. Instead of cheats, he was offered three months of training at an otherworldly reincarnation training facility. The training facility was supposed to make it relatively easy to acquire skills, but what would he accomplish in three short months? He was given an Appraisal and an Item Box as bonus skills, but he was thrown into the training facility before he could even begin to set up his prowess.

He spent three months in the training facility, desperately training to survive his new life. But after 3 months, after 1 year, after 10 years, he was not reincarnated. He was worried he might have gone to the infinite hell of the game world since he died from playing too much video games, but he still trained desperately. In fact, he never thought that the reincarnation process was not completed due to a mistake made by the female guide. After all, when 15 years of training had passed, the information about reincarnation came unexpectedly. The man who had already become a cheat bastard to the point of killing an ancient dragon was trying his best to enjoy the other world in a normal way.

description.en:
Karen and Miyu grew closer after entering high school and ending up in the same class. As they spend more time together, they find themselves increasingly drawn to one another, and little by little, the distance between them begins to close. They start noticing each other's little gestures and habits, and even feel jealous when they see the other getting along with someone else. At times, they even wonder whether the feelings they have for each other are wrong…

But who cares what other people think?! Wanting to take their relationship one step further, the two finally gather the courage to confess their feelings to each other.

…And this is the story of the knights who, working behind the scenes, fight with everything they've got to protect the precious relationship between these two girls!
description.ja:
### あの聖域（はなぞの）を絶対に侵（じゃま）すんじゃねぇぞ！！
高校に入学して同じクラスになったことをきっかけに距離が近づいた華恋と美優。時を重ねていくことで二人は惹かれ合い、徐々に距離を縮めていく。
ふとした仕草や癖が気になり、他の人と仲良くしていることに嫉妬を覚え始めてしまう。
「こんな関係、間違っているのかな…」なんて戸惑う日も…。
でも周りなんて関係ない！もう一歩踏み込んだ関係になるべく、二人は自分の気持ちをお互いに伝えようと勇気を振り絞った！

…これはそんな二人の尊い関係を死守すべく、人知れず奮闘する騎士（おとこ）たちの物語。

Elas passam a reparar nos pequenos gestos e manias uma da outra e até sentem ciúmes quando veem a outra se dando bem com alguém. Às vezes, chegam a se perguntar se o que sentem uma pela outra é errado...

Mas quem se importa com o que os outros pensam?! Querendo dar mais um passo nessa relação, as duas finalmente reúnem coragem para tentar revelar seus sentimentos uma à outra.

...E esta é a história dos cavaleiros que, agindo às escondidas, lutam com todas as forças para proteger a preciosa relação entre essas duas garotas!

description.en:
This spinoff manga starts from the end of Volume 1 of Light Novel, although its more like a parody.

After an encounter with Shizu-san, Rimuru learns the art of mimicking humans. However, his appearance was somehow changed to that of a three-year-old...! The smaller Rimuru is, the more mischievous and troublesome he becomes! The monsters in the Jura Forest can't help but pamper him!
description.es-la:
Este es un Spinoff parodia de la franquicia de Tensura, comenzando en el final del Volumen 1 de la Novela Ligera.

Después de un encuentro con Shizu, Rimuru aprende la habilidad de imitar a los humanos. ¡Sin embargo, su apariencia cambió de alguna manera a la de un niño de tres años...! ¡Cuánto más pequeño es Rimuru, más travieso y problemático se vuelve! ¡Los monstruos del Bosque de Jura no pueden evitar mimarlo!

description.en: Sakura is a high school girl who loves to clean. One day, she suddenly crashes into a Demon King from another world. Apparently, this world has fallen prey to a curse that forbids the use of cleaning magic...!? A modern-day high school student in an unknown world... can be useful by "cleaning"!?
description.ja: お掃除が大好きな現代の女子高生・さくらはある日突然、見知らぬ異世界へ飛ばされてしまう。彼女が着いたところはツノが生えたイケメンの（でも、とてもものぐさな）魔王様が治める魔王領…。ただこの魔王領は“綺麗にする魔法”の使用が呪いで禁じられており、魔王様の懐である魔王城も汚れ放題。あまりの汚さに思わず掃除を始めたさくらだったが、何と誰にも綺麗にすることのできなかった汚れを一拭きで落としてしまった。見知らぬ異世界で、美化委員の女子高生がお掃除で大活躍！果たして魔王城や魔王領を綺麗にすることはできるのか…！？

description.en: By chance, Wataru discovers a gate that allows him to travel between Japan and a different world, and makes a lot of money by bringing sugar and other goods into the new world.
description.ja: 渡はある日、偶然にも異世界と日本を行き来できるゲートを発見した。ゲートの先に広がっていたのはファンタジーのような世界。文明的に未発展な部分も多い町を見て渡は大儲けできる可能性に気付く。それは砂糖や香辛料にコーヒー、衛生用品などを異世界に持ち込んで大金をせしめる事。異世界で大金持ちになった渡はそこで売られているポーションを見てふと気づいてしまう。「これは異世界の方が優れてるんじゃね？」　使用者の傷を瞬く間に治す傷薬を地球に持ち込み大儲けする渡。さらに美しい奴隷を買った渡はやがて地球でも大活躍していくことに。

description.en:
In a world just a little further in the future, one night, Iroha, a caring and highly skilled high school girl, picks up Kaguya, a princess from the moon. At Kaguya's invitation, the energetic and unconventional, the two decide to become live streamers (liver) in the virtual world "Tsukuyomi." As the girls deepen their bond through music, their destinies begin to unfold.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
description.ja: 今より少しだけ未来の世界。ある晩、世話焼きハイスペック女子高生・彩葉が拾ったのは、月からやってきたお姫様・かぐやだった。元気いっぱいで破天荒なかぐやに誘われて、二人は仮想空間『ツクヨミ』で配信者（ライバー）活動をすることに。音楽で絆を深めていく彼女たちの運命が今、動き出す――。
description.tr:
Yakın geleceğin biraz daha ötesindeki bir dünyada, bir gece; şefkatli ve yetenekli bir lise öğrencisi olan Iroha, Ay’dan gelen prenses Kaguya ile karşılaşır. Enerjik ve alışılmışın dışındaki Kaguya’nın davetiyle bu ikili, sanal dünya “Tsukuyomi“de canlı yayıncı (livestreamer) olmaya karar verirler. Genç kızlar müzik aracılığıyla bağlarını derinleştirdikçe, kaderleri de şekillenmeye başlar.

Bu, “Prenses Kaguya“nın daha önce hiç görülmemiş bir hikayesidir.

(Kaynak: Kadokawa, çevrilmiş)

description.en:
After the death of her only relative, Hikaru, who was fostered in a strange man's house, and the tall and handsome calligrapher Kiyomizu, who seems to be unreliable, will have a warm story.  

**Note:** It started as a Oneshot, but later began serialization in Lala issue May 2020.
description.it: Hikaru Takatsukasa ha perso il padre. A prendersi cura di lei rimane unicamente il calligrafo Kiyomizu Kuzukiri, cresciuto dalla famiglia Takatsukasa e maestro di shodo, l’arte della scrittura. Apatica e inespressiva, Hikaru rimane affascinata dal modo in cui Kiyomizu si preoccupa per lei, nonostante la sua freddezza. La ragazza punterà forse a diventare la sposa del nuovo tutore? Ecco alzarsi il sipario sulla caotica convivenza tra una bella e sfortunata giovane e un calligrafo rude ma dal cuore tenero!
description.ja:

無気力・無表情な輝だったが、一見冷たいのに自分を気にかけてくれる清水に惹かれはじめ「清水のお嫁さん」を目指すことに!?

description.en: Suddenly a high school student Subaru Natsuki has been summoned to another world on the way back from the convenience store. With the biggest crisis of his life being summoned to another world and no sign of the one who summoned him things become worse when he is attacked. But when he is saved by a mysterious silver-haired girl with a fairy cat, Subaru co-operates with the girl to return the favor. When they finally manage to get a clue Subaru and the girl are attacked and killed by someone. Subaru then awakens in the place he was summoned and notices the ability he gained "Returns by Death" a helpless boy that only has the ability to rewind time by dying. And beyond the despair can he save the girl from the fate of death!
description.ru: После спасения жизни Эмилии и возвращения ей инсигнии, Нацуки Субару был приглашен в особняк к лорду, где живет Эмилия. Нацуки устраивается на работу дворецким, и всё идёт хорошо, но вот только спустя несколько дней обнаруживается, что он опять откатился назад во времени, на момент, когда он только появился в особняке. Кто же в этот раз замочил бедного Нацуки?
description.pt-br: O estudante do ensino médio Natsuki Subaru foi convocado para um mundo de fantasia, enquanto estava nocaminho para casa vindo de uma loja de conveniência! Com base em seu conhecimento de histórias onde as pessoas são transportados para outros mundos, ele assumiu que ele deve ter algum tipo de super poder, mas essa suposição acabou deixando ele espancadoe quase morto durante um assalto. Ele é resgatado por uma meio-elfo, Satera, e seu companheiro, um gato mágico pequeno chamado Puck. Eles estão procurando por algo que foi roubado dela, e Subaru decide ajudar. No entanto, muito em breve, ele descobre que ele de fato tem uma habilidade especial. Quando ele morre, ele começa sua aventura novamente a partir do momento em que ele foi convocado para o mundo de fantasia. Será que ele vai ser capaz de usar sua habilidade para ajudar Satera?

description.en:
The story revolves around four teenagers; Akina, Hime, Ao, and Kotoha; each of them having their own unique abilities. They run an office called Hiizumi Life Counseling Office, where their job is to help and protect the townspeople of Sakurashin, a town where humans and youkai co-exist with one another. The town is protected by a barrier created by the spiritual sakura known as The Seven Pillars. The Seven Pillars exist in both the human world and the youkai world and is the only thing that keeps both worlds connected to each other. However, recent bizarre incidents have occurred in their town and someone has threatened the safety of their town. It is up to the four of them to protect the town they love.

---

description.ja: 夜の桜新町に続発する奇怪な事件。人外の力を得た者たちの跋扈、混沌の度を深める桜並木の町。それに立ち向かうは『比泉生活相談事務所』の面々だ！
description.vi: Truyện xoay quanh 4 nhân vật chính là Hime, Akina, Ao và Kotoha, mỗi người đều có những kỹ năng đặc biệt của riêng mình. Họ có mở 1 văn phòng tên là "văn phòng tư vấn cuộc sống Hiizumi" để giúp đỡ và bảo vệ những người dân của Sakurashin - 1 thành phố nơi người và yêu có thể chung sống với nhau. Thành phố được bảo vệ nhờ vào kết giới tạo ra từ Thất Trụ. Thất Trụ tồn tại ở cả thế giới của yêu và người và là thứ duy nhất kết nối 2 thế giới. Tuy nhiên, có người đang muốn làm thất trụ nở hoa nhằm dung hợp 2 chiều không gian, khi đó yêu quái của bên kia sẽ tràn vào bên này. Hime và động bọn phải hành động ngay trước khi quá muộn.

description.en:
His name is Touji, 20 years old. Following a certain incident that made him infamous, his only way get by is by working insconspicuous part-time jobs without involving himself with others. 

One day, while working at a supermarket, he gets dragged into a conflict between an employee and a rude Customer and ends up getting acquainted with a beautiful high school girl named Sakuya. 

Though she is blessed with an astounding memory, which some even call her ''super eye'', she struggles to adjust to her school life. In this illustrated human drama, those two who have difficulty adapting to this cruel society begin their share-house lifestyle and grow together.
description.ja: ある事件をきっかけに有名になってしまい、誰とも交わらず、目立つことなくバイトで生計を立てているフリーターの冬至、20歳。スーパーのバイト中に客同士のトラブルに巻き込まれて、美人の女子高生・咲夜と接点を持つことになる。咲夜はスーパーアイという驚異的な記憶力のギフテッドだが、学校生活に適応できずにいた。そんな社会に馴染めていない2人がシェアハウスで生活を始め、共に成長していく姿を描くヒューマンドラマ。
description.vi:
Tên anh là Touji, 20 tuổi. Sau một sự cố khiến anh trở nên khét tiếng, cách duy nhất để anh sống sót là làm những công việc bán thời gian kín đáo mà không liên quan đến người khác.

Một ngày nọ, khi đang làm việc tại một siêu thị, anh bị kéo vào một cuộc xung đột giữa một nhân viên và một Khách hàng thô lỗ và cuối cùng làm quen với một nữ sinh trung học xinh đẹp tên là Sakuya.

Mặc dù được ban tặng một trí nhớ đáng kinh ngạc, mà một số người thậm chí còn gọi là "siêu mắt", cô vẫn phải vật lộn để thích nghi với cuộc sống ở trường. Trong bộ truyện này, hai con người gặp khó khăn trong việc thích nghi với xã hội tàn khốc bắt đầu cuộc sống chung và cùng nhau trưởng thành.

Shiro könnte zwar auch locker als Mädchen durchgehen, er ist aber der erste Junge, der Mei seine Liebe erklärt. Der feminine Schönling steht total drauf, für Mei zu backen und zu nähen, und schmeißt sich für seine Angebetete auch gern mal in ein Cheerleader-Kostüm, um sie beim Sport anzufeuern. Obwohl Mei ihm immer wieder die kalte Schulter zeigt, lässt Shiro nicht locker, denn für ihn steht fest: die beiden sind füreinander bestimmt!
description.en:
Mei Sengoku is an independent girl and captain of her high school kendo club who enjoys helping others in need. This has earned her a lot of admirers among the girls at her school, as well as a guy named Shirou Fuji well-known at school for his girly way of speaking and gestures. When Shirou asks Mei to go out with him, she simply rejects him, but he comes back the next day and tells her he's not going to give up on her so easily.

description.fr:
Avec My Fair Honey Boy, Junko Ike livre une œuvre décapante et bourrée d'énergie positive! Tout en déconstruisant les stéréotypes de genre, elle signe son premier best-seller, qui ne manquera pas de vous arracher quelques fous rires. En plus de proposer un personnage masculin assez unique, la mangaka va également, tout au long de la série, mettre en scène des personnages féminins très variés, aussi bien en terme de physiques que de caractères.

Mei Sengoku, présidente et capitaine du club de kendo, est particulièrement populaire! Connue pour son calme légendaire, elle plaît autant aux filles qu'aux garçons. Mais son stoïcisme à toute épreuve pourrait bien être ébranlé par un certain Shirô Fuji: parce qu'il est très efféminé, tout le monde a tendance à penser qu'il est gay. Mais il n'en est rien! Éperdument amoureux de Mei, il va un jour lui déclarer son amour... L'adolescente, prise au dépourvu, ne va pas savoir comment le repousser! L'insistance attendrissante (et pas vraiment virile) du garçon viendra-t-elle à bout de la lycéenne?!
description.it: Mei Sengoku è una ragazza indipendente, capitano del club di kendo della sua scuola e desiderosa di aiutare tutte le persone in difficoltà. Questo suo carattere le ha permesso di avere una folta schiera di ammiratrici tra le compagne di scuola, così come ha attirato l'interesse di Shirou Fuji, un ragazzo conosciuto per i suoi modi femminei nel parlare e comportarsi. Quando Shirou chiede a Mei di uscire con lui, la ragazza lo rifiuta ma lui torna alla carica il giorno dopo dicendole che non è intenzionato a rinunciare a lei così facilmente.
description.ja: 強さを求めてひた走り、「侍」の異名を持つ剣道部主将・仙石芽衣。女子力高く仕草や口調は女の子、女装も辞さないオネエ男子・藤司郎。真逆の2人だけど、オネエ男子が侍女子にまさかの恋。告白攻撃を侍女子が叩き斬る!? 「新しい扉、開けるわよ。」ツッコミ不在(!?)のハイテンションラブコメ!!
description.ru: Мэй Сэнгоку — капитан школьной сборной по кэндо. Она целеустремленная и независимая девушка, которая любит помогать тем, кто нуждается в помощи. Неудивительно, что в школе у неё так много поклонниц среди девушек. Однако в их число попал и парень по имени Сиро Фудзи, который известен в школе своими женственными манерами. Когда Сиро признается Мэй в своих чувствах, она тут же отвергает его, но он не намерен сдаваться так просто.
description.pt-br: Mei Sengoku é uma garota independente e capitã do clube de kendo do ensino médio, que gosta de ajudar os outros necessitados. Isso lhe rendeu muitos admiradores entre as garotas da escola, assim como um cara chamado Shirou Fuji, bem conhecido na escola por seu jeito feminino de falar e agir. Quando Shirou pede para Mei sair com ele, ela simplesmente o rejeita, mas ele não vai desistir dela tão facilmente.
